 Follow us on Facebook Twitter Hello Soccer MLS LaLiga World Cup Premier League Champions League CONCACAF Champions USWNT Serie A Bundesliga Ligue 1 Liga mexicana Europa League With 21 points after 11 rounds, Club América lead the Mexican league, but their position at the top comes with an unusual statistical distinction.
 --MexSport Agency-- Liga MX América are flying high in Liga MX, but the numbers reveal a worrying trend
 Carlos Zúñiga twitter Calum Roche twitter Update: Oct 15th, 2026 10:40 EDT 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google With 11 rounds played and several teams still having games in hand in the Apertura 2026 tournament , Club América sit top of the Liga MX standings with 21 points , just one ahead of Toluca. The difference is that Las Águilas are among the teams that have played one game fewer.
 Those 21 points represent the lowest total for a league leader at this stage of the season in the past five years . Curiously, the previous lowest totals also belong to the Mexico City club.

 Even if América were to collect all three points from their game in hand, they would reach 24, matching their total at this stage of the Apertura 2023 tournament, when they not only finished the regular season top of the standings but also went on to win the title .
 Santiago Bueno celebrates. --MexSport Agency-- That would also take them past the 22 points they had in Apertura 2021, Santiago Solari’s second tournament in charge, when they likewise finished the regular season at the top of the table.
